newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA MEAT SAYS RAKVERE BOUGHT MINORITY STAKE.
newsitem.headline: RIGA MEAT SAYS RAKVERE BOUGHT MINORITY STAKE.

text.p: Riga Meat factory (Rigas Miesnieks) said that Rakvere Meat processor has acquired less than 51 percent of its shares, the newspaper Diena said on Friday.

"Rakvere for the time being has less than 51 percent of our shares but will become the controlling shareholder within three months," Harijs Tarvans, Riga Meat board chairman, was quoted as saying by the paper.
Rakvere said on Thursday that it had acquired 67 percent of the Latvian company.
Tarvans declined to say exactly how big Rakvere's stake was at present, but said that the sum of five million lats reported by the media earlier was an exaggeration, Diena reported.

Rigas Miesnieks will continue as a joint-venture under the same name, Tarvans said told the paper, adding that the funds derived from the sale will be used for the reconstruction and development of the company.
Riga Meat had a 1996 profit of 350,000 to 400,000 lats on turnover of 17.6 million lats.
